question: Does request-local lexical reuse reduce work without changing admitted readings, answers or limits?
method: One approved balanced A1/B1/B2/A2 exercise after builds finished; each run one fresh native process, unchanged predeclared100 questions and config, warm filesystem caches. A is committed composed-reader control, B adds lexical reuse. Each query records perf_counter wall and process_time CPU including native/Python/SQLite work. No original whole-only rerun or additional questions.
